page_title: OSA 1-1 RMA | Osasuna v Real Madrid 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+3' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) is able to continue to play.
90+2' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+2' The attendance is 22390.

90+1' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Sergio Herrera pulls off a brilliant save.
90+1' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Corner kick. Osasuna will have an opportunity.
88' The possession of the ball – 43:57.
87' Substitution. Ante Budimir is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
85' Jose Munuera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Abel Bretones (Osasuna).

82' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the right post. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
81' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

80' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Thibaut Courtois makes a comfortable save.
79' Vicente Moreno decides to make a substitution. Jon Moncayola will be replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
79' A substitution has been made. Bryan Zaragoza goes off and Moi Gomez (Osasuna) comes on.
78' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
78' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Real Madrid win a corner.
77' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
75' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
73' Jose Munuera shows the yellow card to Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) for a heavy challenge.
73' Foul! Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
71' The ball is cleared after Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
71' Good clearance! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
69' The referee allows time for a substitution. Brahim Diaz will be replaced by Rodrygo (Real Madrid).
68' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:4.
65' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) commits a foul during an attacking move.
64' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
62' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
59' Vicente Moreno has decided to substitute Juan Cruz and he is replaced by Abel Bretones (Osasuna).
59' Substitution. Jesus Areso makes way for Ruben Pena (Osasuna).
58' 1 - 1 Goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Thibaut Courtois to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
58' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
57' A yellow card for a tackle by Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid). Jose Munuera doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
57' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Osasuna!

56' Play continues despite the shouts by some Osasuna players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Jose Munuera interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
55' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Osasuna for a penalty. Play continues.
55' A rebound spins to Ante Budimir (Osasuna) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the left post.
52' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) sees a yellow card from Jose Munuera after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
50' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jose Munuera stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
49' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
48' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jose Munuera didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
47' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Jose Munuera blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
43' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
39' That was really pointless. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) was being offensive and couldn't control himself. He gave Jose Munuera no choice but to send him off.

39' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
38' A pass by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
37' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) tries to find Kylian Mbappe, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
33' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Munuera no option but to blow his whistle.
33' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

32' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Sergio Herrera is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.
30' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
28' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Osasuna comes to nothing.

28' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
25' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Munuera saw the whole situation.
24' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
21' Referee Jose Munuera halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Carlo Ancelotti, then shows him a yellow.
20' Osasuna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
20' A cross from Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Osasuna earn a corner.
19' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Osasuna.
15' 0 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Federico Valverde finds Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball in the roof of the net. 0:1.
12' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

10' A pass travels right across the box to Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom right corner, but Sergio Herrera denies him with a decent save.
9' The corner is swung in but Real Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
8' An attempted cross from Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) is cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
6' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
4' Flag goes up against Luka Modric (Real Madrid) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
3' Luka Modric swings the cross over. Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
2' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
Jose Munuera will supervise the game today.
